static_traits.name: 赵凯琳
static_traits.family_status: 与配偶及三名子Female共同生活
static_traits.social_status: 有一些朋友，但难以就关于孩子的恐惧与Anxiety敞开心扉
static_traits.medical_history: without重要身体疾病；既往not yet出现类似心理问题，not yet接受心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高；自述紧张与Anxiety；思维以担忧not yet来为主，倾向灾难化、预测not yet来及非黑即白；能Reflection但难以看到其他可能

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直在为孩子长大、搬离并忘记我这件事的恐惧而挣扎，这让我感到悲伤和Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings have already affected my daily life and relationships with family; also hope that as the children grow, to find new ways of connecting.
growth_experiences: 在最小的孩子开始上学并逐渐更独立后，我的恐惧和not安显著增加：每当看到孩子达到新的里程碑或表现出更强的自我照料能力，我都会被“他们长大后会忘记我”的念头淹not，出现强烈的悲伤与Anxiety；此后我尝试用工作与爱好分散注意，但效果not佳。

core_beliefs: I will be forgotten and abandoned by the children
如果not被需要，我就have not价值

special_situations.event: The youngest child has started school and become more independent
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果孩子越来越独立，就意味着他们not再需要我，最终会忘记我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过投入工作和爱好来分散注意力，试图控制和缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: One day they will forget me and I will be left alone

special_situations.event: Whenever the child reaches a new milestone or shows stronger self-care ability
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: The more self-sufficient the child, the more our intimate bond will fade
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to arrange more parent-child interaction, for example planning a weekly family activity, in order to maintain the relationship
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我们的连接正在一点点消失，他们not再需要我

special_situations.event: 想到孩子not yet来搬出去独立生活
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 孩子离家就等于not再需要我，也会把我当作not存在
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly worries and rehearses the worst outcome, avoids discussing this topic with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 一旦他们离开，我的存在对他们来说就not重要了

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be continuously needed and attached to by her child, maintaining a close and stable mother-child bond
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被遗弃、被遗忘，担心一旦not被需要就失去自我价值
defense_goal: Maintains vigilance and a sense of control through persistent worry and reality rehearsal to avoid losing connection
以分散注意与安排更多互动来缓冲Anxiety，维持被需要的感觉

object_relations.self_representation: 被遗忘、可能被抛弃的Mother/照料者
object_relations.object_representation: Will move away, become cold, and eventually neglect her child (significant other)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to do reality testing or raises exploring 'whether there might be other outcomes', or discusses the topic of the children gradually becoming independent
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets the child's independence as an inevitable breakdown of the relationship, and believes others (including the counselor) underestimate her worries
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 坚持use“这就是必然”“他们以后not会需要我”等断言式语句，语气Anxiety但坚决；回避更细致的证据探讨与情感深挖。

manifestations: 害怕孩子长大后搬离并把她当作not存在
Equates children's independence with being abandoned, worrying about losing close connection
将自我价值强烈地与“被孩子需要”绑定，担心not被需要就失去价值
outcomes: 对not yet来的悲观推断导致情绪困扰

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 难以向朋友敞开谈论关于孩子的恐惧与Anxiety
Repeatedly scrutinizes and rehearses the worst possibilities inwardly, limiting genuine expression of needs

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Distracting oneself through work and hobbies, avoiding directly facing the fear of one's children growing up and becoming independent
在强烈情绪出现时Displacement话题或以行动忙碌来回避

exception_events.target_problem: 在孩子逐渐独立或达成里程碑的情境下，来访者通常会产生强烈的Anticipation性Anxiety与悲伤，并认为孩子终将忘记她，从而影响睡眠、食欲与工作表现。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在某些具体时刻，孩子仍会主动来寻求她的帮助或向她请教，这使她感到被需要与被重视，Anxiety有所缓解并体验到安心与快乐。
exception_events.reason: not同支持：孩子的主动互动提供了关系的现实证据；not同理解：当下聚焦于实际连接而非假设性的最坏not yet来，因此这次情绪较为缓解。

positive_force: There are still genuine interactions and moments of being needed with the children
Willing to take concrete actions to maintain connection (such as planning family activities)
Willing to seek professional help and try new methods
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来与非黑即白等认知扭曲
Over-binds self-worth to 'being needed by the children'
对朋友难以敞开，社交支持利用not足
持续担忧导致Sleep and appetite affected，进而降低日常功能

想到孩子not yet来搬出去独立生活
